test_title: PYST 20: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Look at the number series below and answer the question that follows. Counting should be done from left to right only.

(Note: All numbers are single-digit numbers only.)

(Left) 4 1 8 7 1 5 3 4 2 9 7 3 9 1 9 4 4 4 9 2 9 2 9 8 1 4 9 (Right)

How many odd numbers are there that are immediately preceded by an odd number and immediately followed by an even number?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 4 1 8 7 1 5 3 4 2 9 7 3 9 1 9 4 4 4 9 2 9 2 9 8 1 4 9 (Right)

Now,

Odd numbers are there which are immediately preceded by an odd number and immediately followed by an even number.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd - Odd - Even

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8125e0bef636568463495da6c6d74ecb6680ac80ed4089b1f5fd36aeef4e7b6b.png] 

Thus, there are two such odd numbers, each of which are immediately preceded by an odd number and immediately followed by an even number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".
